name: Impure Thoughts
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must guard their hearts and minds diligently, recognizing that impure thoughts are not harmless but equate to sin in the heart, as Jesus explains in Matthew 5:28. Job’s commitment to purity of vision (Job 31:1) and the call to protect the heart (Proverbs 4:23) emphasize the importance of self-discipline and covenant with God. True love for Christ is demonstrated by obedience to His commandments (John 14:15), which includes the transformation and renewal of the mind to discern and follow God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2).
